title: Slack bridge (a channel to an agent)
description: Brings one Slack channel's messages to your agents and posts their replies back, by polling Slack's Web API with a bot token. No public address is needed.
setup_notes: Create a Slack app at api.slack.com/apps, add the bot scopes channels:history and chat:write, install it to your workspace and copy the Bot User OAuth Token (it starts with xoxb-). Invite the bot to the channel (/invite @yourbot) and copy the channel's id (channel details, at the bottom; it starts with C). Everything lands as a draft: enable the credential under API Credentials, approve the connector under Connectors, then bind the channel to an agent in Bridges.

questions.label: Slack bot token
questions.help: The Bot User OAuth Token, starting with xoxb-. It is stored in the credential's secret store.
